about: Complete ties as Tie spanners with both ends, an open tie kept open, slurs paired by number (G01 §5.10, Appendix A, A22).
spec: G01 Appendix A: a tie start pairs with a stop of the same part, staff and sounding pitch that begins where the tied note ends; unpaired, it stays an open tie (W-TIE-OPEN). Slurs pair by number; the export numbers them again.
